description: US-20 Fold the group choice away on /kunden/neu — the two radios move behind a closed <details> whose summary names the proposed group inline ('Gruppe: Rot — andere Gruppe wählen'), while the suggestion and the two group sizes stay visible. Presentation and e2e only: NO domain, application, port, infrastructure or schema change. A diff touching src/domain, src/application, src/infrastructure or prisma/ means the change was misread. Exactly THREE spec files may be edited — archive.spec.ts, card.spec.ts and reregistration.spec.ts — and only to open the disclosure before checking a radio. Source: tasks/prd-us-20-fold-group-choice.md

userStories.title: The group summary names the proposed group and can be reached by testid
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want the proposed group readable without opening a control, because accepting the proposal is what I almost always do. Source: tasks/prd-us-20-fold-group-choice.md §US-020.1
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/kunden/neu/registration-form.tsx the Gruppe <fieldset> sits inside a <details>, and the <summary> carries data-testid="group-choice-open"
The <summary> names the proposed group inline, e.g. 'Gruppe: Rot — andere Gruppe wählen', with the group WORD wearing GROUP_STYLES[proposal.suggestedGroup] from src/app/accents.ts
The colour never travels without the word: a colour is a distinction only some of the staff can make (US-03.4), and the specs assert the word

de.customers.assignment.suggestedGroup and de.customers.assignment.groupSizes stay OUTSIDE the <details>, visible while it is closed — the two sizes are what an override is decided from, and staff must not have to open the control to see whether the register is lopsided

The <details> KEEPS its open attribute in this story. Closing it here would turn three specs red, because they check #group-RED by CSS id and a radio inside a closed <details> has no bounding box — US-002 closes it together with the spec edits that make it safe
The <details> sits INSIDE the <form>: a <details> is not a form boundary, and the radios must still be submitted with everything else

The radios stay NATIVE <input type="radio"> with defaultChecked on the proposal. The action reads 'group' out of the FormData and Radix's RadioGroup submits nothing of its own (guide rule 3). Do NOT make them controlled — src/app/kunden/[id]/group-control.tsx carries a four-sentence comment on why a controlled radio comes back showing the old group after React resets the form
#group-RED and #group-BLUE keep their ids, their name="group", their values and their defaultChecked behaviour
w-fit IS right on this summary — unlike the archive search's, it is a control rather than a card header
No German literal in the component; every new string lives in src/i18n/de.ts
No spec file is edited in this story
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Full e2e suite passes: npm run test:e2e

Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill against a PRODUCTION build (npm run build && npm run start -- --port 3100, killing any next-server first), reading the ACCESSIBILITY SNAPSHOT: the summary must announce the proposed group, and both radios must be named radio elements once opened

userStories.title: Close the group choice by default, and open it in the three specs that override the group
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want the Zuordnung card to be two lines instead of five, so the submit button is reachable without hunting for it. Source: tasks/prd-us-20-fold-group-choice.md §US-020.2, §US-020.3
acceptanceCriteria: The group <details> renders WITHOUT the open attribute — closed on every load of /kunden/neu
The open/closed state is NOT persisted: no localStorage, no cookie, no server state
tests/e2e/archive.spec.ts, tests/e2e/card.spec.ts and tests/e2e/reregistration.spec.ts each click getByTestId('group-choice-open') before checking #group-RED or #group-BLUE
Each spec opens the disclosure with a real CLICK on the summary. Do NOT use evaluate(d => d.open = true)
tests/e2e/customer-record.spec.ts is NOT touched. It checks getByTestId('group-RED') on the CUSTOMER RECORD, which is a different control in src/app/kunden/[id]/group-control.tsx and stays visible
Those three files are the ONLY specs touched. If any other spec goes red, the fix is in the component
Submitting the registration WITHOUT ever opening the disclosure saves the proposed group — check this by hand as well as by the suite
proposed-number still holds exactly the proposed number, and registration-error is still the testid of at most one element on screen at a time
Measured at 1440x900 on the freshly seeded demo register (npm run db:reset && npm run db:demo): the Zuordnung card is <= 210px tall, and the top of the Aufnehmen button has risen by at least 100px
document.documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth is 0 at 1920, 1280, 1024, 800 and 390
The before and after numbers go in the commit message
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Full e2e suite passes: npm run test:e2e

Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill against a PRODUCTION build: register a household without opening the disclosure and confirm the saved group is the proposed one, then open it and override the group on a second registration
